overloadMerges.note: The doc syntax line has no parenthesized parameter list ('Session : 4D.Session'), so the mechanical parser produced an empty overload with no return type at all; restored the documented 4D.Session return type.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the Session object corresponding to the current session (a web/REST session, a remote user session, a stored procedures session, or a standalone session, depending on the calling process).

constraints: Returns Null if called in a non-REST web process and scalable sessions are disabled on the web server.
When called from a REST process, always returns a REST session object, even if scalable sessions are disabled.
